text: Turns out, Chloe was dating both of them. At the same time.
She told me you were her cousin.
She told me you were her personal trainer!
So Dave and Brad came up with a plan. A very... dramatic plan.
Saturday night. Chloe gets invited to a fancy restaurant. Twice.
Dave turns up. Then Brad turns up. And they both get down on one knee.
The whole restaurant claps as they walk out together. Best friends forever.
Later that night, Chloe's phone buzzes. Pizza Guy: your order is outside.
